blind.description: A stylized wooden barrel planter filled with blooming flowers. The container is a cylindrical wooden tub made of vertical brown planks secured by two dark grey metal hoops with rivets. It is filled with dark soil and dense green leaves supporting multi-petaled flowers in red, golden-yellow, and off-white, each featuring a small yellow center. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled in a stylized, hand-painted video game aesthetic.
blind.from_above: A dense circular cluster of colorful red, yellow, and white blossoms intermingled with green foliage, enclosed by the circular rim of the wooden tub.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-quarter the height of the figure (roughly 1.5 feet tall) and about 1.5 feet in diameter.
